title: Technical Lead - DevSecOps
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:** 
 In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large\-scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 Engineering Manager \- Development is responsible for building a team of highly skilled and high performing software developers. They should be adept in designing highly scalable architectures in cloud native environments and, should work closely with Head of Product Engineering to achieve outcomes. They should be proficient in at least two programming languages like Node.js / Python / Java.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Adani Group:** 
 In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large\-scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 Senior DevOps Engineer will be responsible for implementing and managing secure DevOps practices, focusing on automating processes, securing infrastructure, and optimizing workflows within a dynamic and evolving environment. They will will work closely with cross\-functional teams, ensuring the integration of security into every aspect of the DevOps lifecycle to build resilient, secure, and scalable systems.
   

  

* Key Responsibilities of Role


**Senior DevOps Engineer \- IC**
**Automation And CI/CD Optimization**
 Design, create and optimize CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, contribute to the templatization framework and make sure most pipeline code is reusable across various microservices, implementing best practices for efficiency and reliability.
   

  

**Infrastructure As Code (IaC)**
 Create Terraform Modules that are reusable in various implementation Infrastructure as Code (IAC). Modules have to follow best practices and security guidelines concurred internally. Use Ansible for configuration management and automation of server setups (TSDB, PGPool, Looker VM etc.), ensuring consistency across environments.
   

  

**Containerization And Orchestration**
 Implement secure containerization using tools like Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring security best practices (e.g., secure image scanning, role\-based access control).
   

  

 Automate deployment processes for containerized applications in a secure and efficient manner. Manage complex Kubernetes clusters, including advanced networking, security, and resource management. Create and maintain Helm charts for complex Kubernetes orchestration
   

  

**Cloud Security**
 Work with cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) to design secure cloud infrastructure, ensuring compliance with security frameworks and best practices.
   

  

 Implement security controls such as encryption, IAM, and network security in cloud environments.
   

  

**Incident Response And Threat Detection**
 Investigate and mitigate security incidents and vulnerabilities in a timely and efficient manner.
   

  

 Collaborate with security teams to identify, analyze, and patch security vulnerabilities within the CI/CD pipeline and infrastructure.
   

  

**Collaboration With Development And Security Teams**
 Work closely with developers to ensure security is integrated from the beginning of the development lifecycle.
   

  

 Collaborate with cybersecurity professionals to ensure the infrastructure and applications meet compliance standards.
   

  

**Documentation And Reporting**
 Document the DevOps processes, security procedures, and compliance reports.
   

  

 Ensure accurate and timely reporting of security status and activities to stakeholders and management.
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 Department Heads
   

  

 IT Team
   

  

 Product Management Team
   

  

 Risk Management Teams
   

  

 Project Management Office (PMO)
   

  

 Human Resources
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 Cloud Service Providers
   

  

 Third\-Party Vendors \& Consultants
   

  

 Regulatory Bodies
   

  

 External Auditors
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber, Information Security, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
   

  

 Strong understanding of DevOps principles and practices.
   

  

 Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash).
   

  

 Knowledge of automation tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, Jenkins).
   

  

 Experience with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack).
   

  

 Understanding of network protocols and security best practices.
   

  

 Significant experience in implementing and managing CI/CD pipelines.
   

  

 Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) and configuration management.
   

  

 Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
   

  

 Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
   

  

**Certification**
 AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, or other relevant certifications.
   

  

**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
 5\+ years of experience in DevOps, with at least 2 years in leading DevOps role.

title: Data Loss Prevention Lead
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:** 
 In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large\-scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 The GRC Specialist is responsible for supporting the organization's security governance, conducting risk analysis, ensuring compliance with global regulations, and assisting in security audits. This role works closely with various teams to integrate risk management practices into daily operations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Strategic Roles and Responsibilities:**
* Manage a comprehensive DLP program, including data discovery, classification, and protection policies.
* Conduct DLP and DSPM assessments to identify, mitigate, and report data protection risks.
* Ensure compliance with data protection regulations across multiple geographies.
* Collaborate with legal teams to review contracts and MSAs for DLP compliance.
* Oversee deployment and tuning of disk encryption technologies (e.g., BitLocker).
* Understanding of Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and evaluate vendor risks from a DLP perspective.
* Participate in Architecture Review Board (ARB) reviews to ensure DLP/DAM/DSPM considerations are integrated.
* Manage and respond to data breaches and DLP incidents.
* Stay up to date with the latest DLP trends, threats, and technologies.


**People Management**
* Foster an environment of learning, excellence, and innovation within the team and across teams.
* Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members.
* Conduct performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.
* Ensure continuous professional development of team members.


**Qualifications**
**Educational qualifications \& Experience:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or related field.
* 10–12 years of experience in data loss prevention, data discovery/classification, and database/data security.
* Experience with DSPM tools and integration in hybrid environments.
* Familiarity with security standards and frameworks such as GDPR, ISO 27001, and NIST.
* Experience with DLP, DSPM, disk encryption tools and automation.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CEH, or OSCP are a plus.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to stay up to date with the latest DLP trends, threats, and technologies.
